VRoid Studio sample avatars: AvatarSample_D, AvatarSample_E, AvatarSample_F, AvatarSample_G (VRM 0.x)

Created by pixiv / VRoid Studio (alpha-era samples).
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/vroid-studio-cc0-models
Downloaded: 2026-10-17 (avatarsample_d_0.zip, avatarsample_e.zip, avatarsample_f.zip, avatarsample_g.zip)

http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Note: these samples are unrelated to the current VRoid Studio samples with the same names, and AvatarSample A-C
(released under other terms) are intentionally not included. M1 placeholders only; to be replaced by our own art.
